Anchor.description: One of the 9 points of a box a node is attached to.

BarDirection.description: Direction in which a bar fills; vertical bars default to a tall bounding box.

BarNode.description: Linear indicator. Range limits are in the displayed unit, after conversion.

baseline.description:
Value from which the fill grows. Default zero, clamped into the range;
negative acceleration therefore fills towards the braking side.

max.description: Defaults to 100. Values outside the range saturate the indicator.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

radius.description: Corner radius, in layout units. Default 6.

show_value.description: Draw the formatted value centred on the bar. Default true.

BarZone.description:
An upper zone boundary, in the bar's displayed units. Boundaries must be strictly
increasing from min, with the last equal to max.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

CompassNode.description:
Compass for an angular metric (usually causal GPS `heading`). Heading is in
degrees, clockwise from north. A rotating rose keeps its pointer facing upwards.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

oneOf.description: Time zone of the machine (M2; per-video zones come later).

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

size.description: Font size = height of the text box, in layout units.

FrameNode.description: Group with a size, a background panel, a border and rounded corners.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.

GaugeNode.description:
Circular indicator. Range limits are in display units, as for bars.
Angles run clockwise from the right; the default arc runs from 135° through 270°.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

GroupNode.description:
Container. With `size`, children anchor inside it; without, they are placed
relative to the group's origin (the original's `composite`).

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

HeadingFilter.description:
Optional per-widget smoothing. Omitting the object disables the filter;
`enabled: false` bypasses it while preserving configured thresholds.

icon.description: Name from the embedded icon set (see actionlay-render).

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

marker_radius.description: Radius of the current-position dot, in design pixels; defaults to 5.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

orientation.description: North-up (default) or rotate the map so the direction of travel points up.

route_future.description: Upcoming route color; defaults to yellow. `route` colors the completed part.

route_mode.description: No route (default), completed route only, or the entire available route.

split_route.description: Use separate colors for the completed and upcoming route; defaults to true.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

size.description: Font size = height of the text box, in layout units.

stale_secs.description: How long a stale value stays visible (dimmed) before the empty state. Default 3.

units.description: Unit id overriding the layout's unit system, e.g. "kmh".

[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

size.description: Font size = height of the text box, in layout units.

stale_secs.description: Retain the previous value during missing data, default 3 seconds.

OutlineOpt.description: Text outline (legibility over bright video). `width` in layout units; 0 disables it.

ShadowOpt.description: Hard drop shadow. `offset` in layout units.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

size.description: Font size = height of the text box, in layout units.

TextStyleOpt.description: Text style group shared by text-like widgets; flattened into the widget's JSON object.

size.description: Font size = height of the text box, in layout units.

dim_opacity.description: Alpha multiplier of stale values and empty states (0..=1).

Units.description: Default unit system of a layout (spec §4.4).

WhenAbsent.description:
What a data widget shows when its metric is absent (spec §4.4.1).

`Hide` hides the widget only when the video never has the metric
(`Snapshot::is_available` is false), not during a momentary gap in the data.

ZoneBarNode.description:
A bar whose filled portion passes through coloured zones. The default zones
divide the range into thirds: green, theme accent, red.

baseline.description:
Value from which the fill grows. Default zero, clamped into the range;
negative acceleration therefore fills towards the braking side.

max.description: Defaults to 100. Values outside the range saturate the indicator.

offset.description: [x, y] from the anchor in layout units (positive = right/down). Default [0, 0].

offset_relative.description:
Additional offset as fractions of the parent's width and height.
[0.02, -0.02] gives a 2% inset at a bottom-left anchor.

radius.description: Corner radius, in layout units. Default 6.

show_value.description: Draw the formatted value centred on the bar. Default true.

design_aspect.description: Default 16:9; used by the `fit` scale mode.
